verdicts.evidence: SKILL.md:17 "E2E testing specialist with deep expertise in Playwright for robust, maintainable browser automation." (also frontmatter description at line 3, scoped entirely to Playwright/browser testing)
verdicts.reasoning: Verified in KICKOFF.md (lines 939-944, gate-automation dispatch): the operator prompt tells the dispatched agent to determine the automation surface from repo evidence (web vs mobile vs both) and to prefer repo evidence over CLAUDE.md's Requirement Scope line, then route to playwright-expert for web or test-master for Maestro. The playwright-expert skill is Playwright-only end to end (title, description, all five references/ files, Knowledge Reference list) and has zero awareness of test-master or of any platform-detection logic — it cannot know it is one of two sibling skills being selected between. This is dispatch-level routing that belongs to the invocation, not the skill. KEEP.
